title: Vector test output: name the failing vector case
description: When a shared vector test fails in Rust (shared_vectors.rs) or Python (test_vectors.py), output shows a panic/assertion at a line number but not which of the 201 vector files or which case within a file failed. Fix: Python — use pytest parametrize with vector filename + case index as ID. Rust — use rstest or include vector filename and case index in .expect()/panic!() in the loop body. Low effort, high payoff for cross-impl conformance debugging.
